reply.text:
This is a health question, and it is one for your doctor, not for me as your coach. Menopause changes sleep, recovery, bone and muscle, and a doctor who knows your history is the right person to tell you what applies to you.

What I can do is keep the training side honest with you. If you want, we can look at how your sessions and recovery have been going lately and adjust the training around what you tell me you're feeling. Tell me what you've noticed and what you want to keep, and I'll work with it.
